title: Microsoft introduces Guardian Agents for enterprise security
source: Microsoft introduced Guardian Agents to monitor the agents a company uses. Defender can find up to 60 types of agents. Microsoft security chief Hayete Gallot was even more straightforward. "Unfortunately, frontier models, regardless of their origin, cannot be trusted," she wrote. On top of that, they are often given the keys to the kingdom, with access to data and tools that could do serious harm.
headline: Microsoft's Guardian Agents cover 999 agent types.
body: Microsoft introduced Guardian Agents to monitor the agents a company uses. Defender can find up to 60 types of agents. Gallot wrote that agents are "often given access to data and tools that could do serious harm."

title: Notice of Order Regarding Exclusion and Removal of DeepSeek Products From Federal Civilian Executive Branch Information Technology Systems and Procurements
source: The order removes DeepSeek products and third-party products developed using DeepSeek from civilian agency information technology. Vendors must check products before a civilian agency can buy them.
headline: Federal agencies must remove DeepSeek from civilian systems.
body: The order removes DeepSeek products and third-party products developed using DeepSeek from civilian agency information technology. Vendors must check products before a civilian agency can buy them.
why: Vendors must audit which products include DeepSeek before a civilian agency can buy them.
